high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram ad from the account "newthingslab." The ad is labeled as "1 of 4" and marked as sponsored. It features a person holding a clipboard with a whiteboard attached to it. The whiteboard has a handwritten habit tracker for the days of the week (Monday through Friday). The habit tracker includes four categories: Exercise, Eat Healthy, Meditate, and Journal. Each category has a column for each day of the week, with checkmarks or X marks indicating whether the habit was completed or not. Exercise: Checked on Monday and Tuesday. Eat Healthy: Checked
